company.name: Statespace
company.shortDescription: Statespace provides performance analytics and a suite of tools for casual gamers and esports athletes to maximize their potential.
company.description: StateSpace provides performance analytics and a suite of tools for casual gamers and esports athletes to maximize their potential. It uses cognitive science and artificial intelligence to revolutionize the way humans improve. Leveraging expertise as neuroscientists, data scientists, video game developers, and computer visionaries, the products bring much needed standardized performance analytics to train.It was founded in 2017 and is headquartered in New York, New York.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Venture round round raised $17,156,948, or 14.39% of reported total funding.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $5,893,818 to $446,859,188, a 75.82x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.
